summary: Rabbi Hidary continues looking at Tanaetic sources in Masechet Arachin that say Hakol Hayavin. He explains why Kohanim, Levim, and Yisraelim stop their service in the Bet HaMikdash to read Megilat Ester. He also looks at laws of Zimun, Machasit HaShekel, and Arakhin vows.
